Now I will teach you Lightning. Big fire in sky, very fast, like spear of light from cloud to ground or cloud to cloud. Makes big sound after, like angry rock fall. Happens when sky is dark and heavy with water. It is hot, bright, and can hurt if it touches you. Do not stand under tall thing when it happens. this is Lightning.

Now think about thunder, fire, and wind.
